2 03-09-2025 We find from the records that the aforesaid appeal arises out of the judgment of conviction dated 22.03.2025, whereby and whereunder the appellant has been convicted under Sections 363, 366A,
376 and 506 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 4 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012, thus it is imperative to add the victim and her father (informant) as party respondents to the present appeal and issue notice to them.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: However, we find that their identity is required to be masked and shall not be disclosed in the records placed in public domain.

2. Having regard to the law on the subject matter, we direct the Registry to add P.W.6 (father of the victim/informant) Patna High Court CR. APP (DB) No.811 of 2025(2) dt.03-09-2025 and P.W.3 (prosecutrix/victim girl), details whereof has been mentioned in the records of the learned Trial Court, as respondent nos. 2 & 3 to the present appeal.
However, as far as P.W.6 is concerned, he would be mentioned as Mr.X and as far as P.W.3 is concerned, she shall be depicted as Ms.Z.
We further direct that the actual names of P.W.6 & P.W.3 as also their residential details and other particular shall be mentioned in a sheet of paper and sealed in an envelope and kept on record.

3. List this matter after a week under the same heading.
